curriculum.title: Path
curriculum.blurb: Left is start. Right is the interview. Same-column units can be done in any order.

stages.label: Kernel
stages.blurb: Cost and layout before any pattern.

stages.label: Index
stages.blurb: Remember what you have seen. Scan from both ends.

stages.label: Window
stages.blurb: A live range, a waiting stack, a pointer chain.

stages.label: Runtime
stages.blurb: Keep the k hottest. Forget the rest.

stages.label: Graph
stages.blurb: Shape first, then the call stack, then walk, then order.

stages.label: Wire
stages.blurb: Memory, downloads, concurrency, and transaction isolation.

stages.label: Frame
stages.blurb: How to spend forty-five minutes, then the cheap building blocks.

stages.label: Box
stages.blurb: Request paths, state, and failures in focused design cases.

stages.label: Harness
stages.blurb: Models, execution environments, tools, and permissions.

stages.label: Judge
stages.blurb: Measure outcomes and practice explaining the evidence.

schedule.title: Path
schedule.blurb: Sessions, not calendar dates. One sitting at a time.

lessons.title: Diagnose agent failures before changing the prompt
lessons.summary: Trace failures to observable evidence, repair the responsible component, and add a focused regression case.

lessons.title: A next-pointer that loops
lessons.summary: Walk a linked chain with a slow pointer and a fast pointer; if they meet, the chain loops.

lessons.title: Contiguous slots versus pointer chasing
lessons.summary: Arrays provide indexed access and compact storage; linked lists support local splices when you already have the required node references.

lessons.title: Expand level by level
lessons.summary: Use a queue to visit nodes in distance order so the first time you reach a node is the shortest unweighted path.

lessons.title: Big-O as a conversation
lessons.summary: Big-O is how you name the bottleneck and compare plans, not a stopwatch reading.

lessons.title: Binary search the feasible number
lessons.summary: Search the numeric answer, not the array index, by testing a monotonic feasibility predicate.

lessons.title: Upload large objects with resumable parts
lessons.summary: Design versioned multipart uploads, verified completion, durability, and explicit read-revocation behavior.

lessons.title: Shift briefings by depth
lessons.summary: Queue the nodes of one depth, drain that whole depth, then the children you enqueued are the next briefing.

lessons.title: Remembering the expensive answer nearby
lessons.summary: Choose cache keys, freshness rules, and recovery behavior from the workload rather than adding a cache by default.

lessons.title: Consistency promises during failures
lessons.summary: Define what each read and write promises, then explain how partitions and replica lag affect that promise.

lessons.title: Measure new capabilities and protect established behavior
lessons.summary: Measure new capabilities while protecting established behavior, with explicit severity and uncertainty rules.

lessons.title: Crawl a bounded catalog politely
lessons.summary: Coordinate a durable crawl frontier with host budgets, destination checks, deduplication, and revisits.

lessons.title: Order messages and resume delivery
lessons.summary: Persist ordered conversation messages and resume delivery independently for each device.

lessons.title: One dead chunk is not a dead file
lessons.summary: Preserve verified ranges and retry eligible missing parts under bounded attempts, backoff, and cancellation.

lessons.title: Evaluate patches against behavior and preserved contracts
lessons.summary: Test submitted patches against the requested behavior, preserved contracts, and independent grading evidence.

lessons.title: Fewest tokens for a fare
lessons.summary: Fill a one-dimensional table of fewest tokens for each amount so greedy mistakes cannot hide in a local choice.

lessons.title: Training modules with prereqs
lessons.summary: Emit directed modules with indegree zero; if not all modules can be emitted, the graph contains a cycle.

lessons.title: Build a chat assistant with durable jobs and authorized tools
lessons.summary: Acknowledge verified chat requests after durable intake, then run bounded jobs with authorized tools.

lessons.title: Count routes using only right and down
lessons.summary: Fill a grid where each cell is paths-from-above plus paths-from-the-left, so you count routes without walking them.

lessons.title: Explore, undo, try the next branch
lessons.summary: Walk a decision tree depth-first, pushing a choice onto the path and popping it before the next try.

lessons.title: A name is not an address
lessons.summary: DNS is a cached tree walk from a stub to an authoritative name, not a magic lookup of a hostname.

lessons.title: Reuse the last few answers
lessons.summary: Define a one-dimensional subproblem and reuse earlier answers under the recurrence’s dependency order.

lessons.title: Fill a grid of overlapping subproblems
lessons.summary: When the state needs two indices, fill a table in an order that only reads already-solved cells.

lessons.title: Bytes are not characters
lessons.summary: Separate UTF-16 units, Unicode code points, grapheme clusters, and UTF-8 bytes before counting, comparing, or truncating text.

lessons.title: Separate the system doing the work from the system measuring it
lessons.summary: Separate the configured system performing a task from the fixtures, evidence, and graders measuring it.

lessons.title: Two speeds, one list
lessons.summary: Move two pointers at different speeds to find a cycle, a midpoint, or the k-th node from the end without extra memory.

lessons.title: Distribute versioned feature decisions
lessons.summary: Distribute validated rule versions and define stable assignment, propagation targets, and stale-value behavior.

lessons.title: A download is bytes plus a name
lessons.summary: Track durable bytes, object identity, and response ranges so an interrupted download can resume safely.

lessons.title: Floats are scientific notation, not decimals
lessons.summary: Binary floating point approximates many decimal fractions; choose numeric types, comparison rules, and rounding policies to match the task.

lessons.title: Choose a grader for the evidence available
lessons.summary: Match executable checks, calibrated model judgments, and human review to the properties being evaluated.

lessons.title: Group search tokens by their letters
lessons.summary: Group search tokens by a canonical signature of their letters, preserving duplicates and singletons.

lessons.title: Hash maps as an index
lessons.summary: Trade linear scans for expected constant lookups by storing the fact you will need later.

lessons.title: Why a map is "O(1)" until it isn't
lessons.summary: A hash table is an array of buckets plus a function that turns keys into indexes; collisions and resizes are why we say expected O(1).

lessons.title: Keep only the interesting k
lessons.summary: Stream n items through a size-k heap so you never sort the whole input just to name the extremes.

lessons.title: Build an evaluation from the task contract
lessons.summary: Build representative and targeted tasks from an observable success contract, then compare configurations with protected evaluation cases.

lessons.title: HTTP is a conversation, TCP is the pipe
lessons.summary: TCP delivers a reliable byte stream; HTTP is a request/response language on top of that stream (or on QUIC instead).

lessons.title: Indexes are precomputed answers
lessons.summary: An index can narrow a search, but its benefit depends on query shape, data distribution, result size, and maintenance cost.

lessons.title: Practice AI-assisted coding and evaluation discussions
lessons.summary: Practice reviewing AI-assisted work, designing authorized tool workflows, and explaining evaluation evidence.

lessons.title: Forty-five minutes is a navigation problem
lessons.summary: Practice requirements, estimates, request paths, and failure analysis in a bounded system-design discussion.

lessons.title: Schedule occurrences and recover leased work
lessons.summary: Create durable schedule occurrences and recover leased work without confusing lease expiry with a stopped worker.

lessons.title: k-th highest view count
lessons.summary: Keep the k largest observed values and compare a simple sorted buffer with a scalable min-heap.

lessons.title: Calibrate a judge on held-out decisions
lessons.summary: Calibrate a qualitative judge on reviewed examples and report held-out error counts with explicit denominators.

lessons.title: Budget model memory and schedule streamed generation
lessons.summary: Budget model and request memory, schedule prefill and decode, and distinguish stream recovery from a new generation.

lessons.title: Spreading work without creating a new bottleneck
lessons.summary: Route work using useful load signals and account for capacity loss, health checks, and reconnect bursts.

lessons.title: Locks buy correctness, not speed
lessons.summary: A lock serializes a critical section so invariants survive concurrent writers; incorrect lock ordering can deadlock, while unprotected shared state can race.

lessons.title: Longest substring without repeated letters
lessons.summary: Slide a window over a stream of symbols, jumping the left edge past the last repeat so the live slice stays unique.

lessons.title: A lookup cache with least-recently-used eviction
lessons.summary: Combine expected constant-time hash lookup with a doubly linked recency list to update and evict entries.

lessons.title: Collapse overlapping ranges
lessons.summary: Sort ranges by start time, then walk once, merging anything that overlaps the current open interval.

lessons.title: The next greater is waiting on a stack
lessons.summary: Keep a stack of decreasing (or increasing) candidates so each item finds its next greater or smaller in amortized constant time.

lessons.title: Build a feed with bounded fanout
lessons.summary: Combine bounded fanout and read-time merging while preserving durable publication and current visibility rules.

lessons.title: Days until a hotter shift
lessons.summary: Scan left to right and keep a non-increasing stack of waiting days so each new high resolves every cooler day still on the stack.

lessons.title: Route notifications without confusing acceptance and delivery
lessons.summary: Route durable events through authorized channel attempts and distinguish provider acceptance from observed delivery.

lessons.title: Land clusters on a map
lessons.summary: Flood-fill each unvisited land cell and count how many times you start a new fill; that count is the number of islands.

lessons.title: One buy, one sell on the tape
lessons.summary: Walk the price tape once, keep the cheapest buy so far, and record the best sell minus that buy.

lessons.title: Combine controlled tests with production evidence
lessons.summary: Use controlled tests, enforced shadow execution, and bounded production exposure to answer different evaluation questions.

lessons.title: Virtual addresses, physical pages, and locality
lessons.summary: Understand virtual address mappings, page faults, and how locality can affect measured performance.

lessons.title: Grade the result and the constraints that matter
lessons.summary: Grade observable outcomes and required constraints rather than trusting the agent’s report or one preferred tool sequence.

lessons.title: Success across one attempt, retries, and repeated runs
lessons.summary: Distinguish single-attempt success, at-least-one success, and repeated-run reliability without mixing their assumptions.

lessons.title: How to run a pattern-first loop
lessons.summary: Learn reusable ideas through worked examples, independent attempts, feedback, and spaced review.

lessons.title: Make a payment retry refer to one operation
lessons.summary: Preserve one logical capture across retries, different request keys, and uncertain provider responses.

lessons.title: Address spaces versus shared work
lessons.summary: A process is an isolated virtual memory map plus handles; a thread is a stack and a register set that shares that map with its siblings.

lessons.title: At-least-once, idempotency, and the dead-letter lane
lessons.summary: Separate repeated delivery from repeated effects and design crash-safe deduplication at the correct boundary.

lessons.title: Choose retrieval, a workflow, or an adaptive loop
lessons.summary: Choose a retrieval workflow or bounded adaptive loop from the task’s uncertainty and evidence requirements.

lessons.title: A large file is a list of ranges
lessons.summary: Split a large download into fixed byte ranges so you can fetch several slices at once and put them back in order.

lessons.title: Enforce request budgets across servers
lessons.summary: Enforce explicit rolling-window and burst policies atomically across the servers handling one limiting key.

lessons.title: Recursion is a stack you didn't allocate
lessons.summary: Each recursive call pushes a frame; depth is memory, branching is time, and "just recurse" blows up when the graph is not a tree.

lessons.title: A budget for in-flight requests
lessons.summary: Cap how many HTTP calls run at once, queue the rest, and back off when the server says you are too fast.

lessons.title: Reverse a next-pointer chain
lessons.summary: Reverse a singly linked chain in place by swinging each next pointer to the previous node as you walk.

lessons.title: Reserve drivers before confirming a match
lessons.summary: Use approximate locations for candidates and authoritative reservations for offers and trip assignment.

lessons.title: Lookup in a rotated sorted index
lessons.summary: A rotated sorted ring still has one sorted half; binary search the half that is sorted and that can contain the target.

lessons.title: Serve useful suggestions within a latency budget
lessons.summary: Serve versioned prefix candidates within explicit latency, memory, freshness, and removal budgets.

lessons.title: Splitting a keyspace so one box is not the product
lessons.summary: Choose a partition key from queries and explain hot keys, cross-partition invariants, and safe ownership changes.

lessons.title: Choose a maximum sum without adjacent items
lessons.summary: For each item, compare skipping it with taking its score plus the best result before its neighbor.

lessons.title: Grow and shrink a live range
lessons.summary: Maintain a contiguous slice whose invariant you restore by expanding the right edge and shrinking the left.

lessons.title: Every subset of selected items
lessons.summary: Explore include-or-skip decisions and copy the current selection at each completed path.

lessons.title: Choose two boundaries for the largest area
lessons.summary: Compare boundary areas and discard the shorter endpoint because it cannot improve with a narrower partner.

lessons.title: Three-value search
lessons.summary: After sorting, pin one ticket and squeeze the other two with two pointers so every zero-sum triple is found without a cubic scan.

lessons.title: Make tool contracts enforceable
lessons.summary: Enforce tool authorization, semantic validation, replay behavior, and any required scoped user approval.

lessons.title: Order by prerequisites
lessons.summary: Linearize a directed acyclic graph so every edge points forward; a leftover cycle means no legal order.

lessons.title: Use observable execution evidence to diagnose failures
lessons.summary: Link observable actions, spans, trials, and outcomes so failures can be diagnosed without unnecessary sensitive logging.

lessons.title: Isolation defines what concurrent transactions can observe
lessons.summary: A transaction groups reads and writes into one commit-or-rollback; isolation levels name which concurrent anomalies you are willing to see.

lessons.title: Trees are graphs with a promise
lessons.summary: A tree is a connected acyclic graph with one path between any pair; the moment a cycle or a second parent appears, you are in graph land.

lessons.title: Prefix trees as a walking index
lessons.summary: Store strings on shared prefix paths so lookup, prefix check, and autocomplete walk character by character.

lessons.title: Squeeze from both ends
lessons.summary: Walk a sorted sequence from both ends so each comparison discards a whole side of the search.

lessons.title: Pair lookup instead of nested scanning
lessons.summary: Find two values that add to a target by remembering the complement you still need, not by checking every pair.

lessons.title: Cluster membership in nearly constant time
lessons.summary: Maintain disjoint sets with path compression and union by rank so connectivity queries stay almost O(1).

lessons.title: Time-ordered IDs with per-worker sequences
lessons.summary: Understand time-based ID packing and the allocation, restart, and clock rules needed to keep IDs unique.

lessons.title: Create and resolve short links safely
lessons.summary: Create unique short-link mappings safely and resolve them under explicit expiry, replay, and cache policies.

lessons.title: Matched brackets in a line of code
lessons.summary: Push opening brackets onto a stack and pop only when the matching closer arrives; leftover opens or a mismatched pop means the line is illegal.

lessons.title: Evaluate the configuration you actually deploy
lessons.summary: Evaluate the model with the actual tools, permissions, data, and budgets your product deploys.

lessons.title: Publish renditions and serve adaptive playback
lessons.summary: Publish verified video renditions and manifests, then adapt playback using network and buffer measurements.
